source: PyExamine corpus (Shivashankar and Martini, 2025), Zenodo record 14060772; drawn with seed 42, rank 6 (data/selection/candidates_pyexamine.csv)
snippet: whole method iter_entry_points, lines 702 to 714 of the original
trigger: NOFF=3 only (NOC=100 but NOO=18): a generator expression with two for clauses and a condition.
removed_from_original: the rest of pkg_resources (3,361 lines: metadata providers, requirement parsing, the real WorkingSet and Distribution): outside the snippet.
scaffolding: Minimal EntryPoint: name, value and the distribution that declares it.

Minimal Distribution: project name and the entry point map built from a dict; get_entry_map copied (in the original the map is parsed from entry_points.txt when first read; here it is ready at creation, so the AttributeError branch is never taken).
Minimal WorkingSet: iterates the distributions in the order given (the original iterates path entries and skips duplicate projects).
run(distributions, group, name=None): builds the working set, iterates the entry points and returns (project, entry name, value) for each one.
pinned_behavior: typical: every entry point of the group, in distribution order and, inside a distribution, in declaration order.
edge: filtering by name; a name that is not in the group; an unknown group yields nothing.
invalid: a name with group None raises AttributeError (get_entry_map(None) returns the whole map, whose values are dicts, not entry points).
not_pinned_on_purpose: That the result is a lazy generator: a refactoring may return a list.
